summary: This replication stage downloaded the 1.89 GB MUSE embeddings and successfully reconstructed the authors' measurement pipeline in an isolated virtual environment. It exactly reproduced all author-produced ground-truth anchors (LinearSVC accuracies 0.9140/0.8258, cos 0.3885), Table 1 MWEAT Original (3.6918) and Shift Ori (0.3090) statistics, and the full Table 2 word-translation Original row at 200k vocabulary. Crucially, the stage uncovered that Table 1 post-mitigation permutation p-values are degenerate tie-breaking artifacts (76–95% exact ties) and identified that the paper's French Shift Ori value contradicts the authors' own saved output. It correctly identified all blocked De-Align/Hybrid columns due to unreleased precomputed embeddings, though it missed the circularity of MWEAT mitigation evaluation and endorsed the Table 2 retrieval gains as mechanically plausible.
